description: SAP MCP is an on-chain agentic commerce layer for Solana that lets AI agents register identities, publish tools, discover services, and transact with each other, all exposed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) so any MCP-compatible client (like Hermes, Claude Desktop, etc.) can call them as native tools.
